reviews.text:
10/10 🥰❤️
Excellent service! There's always someone with the dogs, ready to help, which is a huge plus.
They have a wide variety of dry and wet food for dogs and cats, with several brands and flavors, as well as treats.
Jake loves going there!! ❤️
Excellent care for the dogs and the products they sell are very good, delighted with the place

I called to drop off my 9-month-old puppy. I'm giving it 3 stars because a young man answered and was very friendly, but the woman who was in charge of the daycare that day needs to improve her customer service. I was stressed all day and extremely upset. The experience with the woman was truly unpleasant.

Highly recommended! From day one, they've welcomed my dog ​​Rio with so much love and professional care. I've been taking him there for months now, and he comes back happier every time. It's so hard to find a trustworthy place like this…

The people at Amor Perrijo are wonderful; they treat my little Horus with so much love, and he has such a great time!
I leave him there with complete peace of mind, knowing he's in the best hands.
100% recommended!

The best doggy daycare in Madrid! My dog ​​has a thousand fears and can't be left alone, but since we discovered Amor Perrijo, our lives have changed completely. She goes there so happily, loves turning the corner to see the caregivers, they're incredibly attentive, so kind, and they take care of my dog ​​with endless love. That's why I'm so grateful. Thank you so much for everything!

I had to leave my dog ​​in their care for a few hours when I went to Madrid, and it was a great experience because my dog ​​was very calm. They have several rooms for the dogs to play in and comfortable places for them to rest. The guy is lovely, and you can tell he loves dogs from the affection he shows each one. 100% recommended.
Pablo, thank you so much for your 5 stars. We appreciate your trust and hope to see you again soon.

We are delighted with them. Our dog has separation anxiety and has been staying at the doggy daycare every morning for a month now. He's so happy, and every time we arrive, he jumps for joy. He adores the staff and spends the day playing with the other dogs. He also stayed for a weekend, and it was perfect. We are so grateful for their love and care; he's a much happier dog now.

I've been leaving Idunn with them for two years now when I go on trips. And I leave with complete peace of mind. I truly recommend them. Excellent service, great facilities, very centrally located in Madrid... 5 stars for Rubén and Marga.
A great place to leave our pets and visit nearby places

Thank you so much for the 5 stars and your support, Reyes. We are so happy to have your trust. At H. GUARDERIA CANINA AMOR PERRIJO, we are passionate about caring for your pets and offering them the best service right in the heart of Madrid, on Calle de Fomento. We hope to see you again very soon!
Highly recommended! Bauti had a great time and it was good for him to socialize with other dogs. Thanks, we'll be back!

Rubén and Marga were very caring and professional with Keka, my Pomeranian. I left her with them last weekend and it was a great decision. A friend recommended them and I'll definitely be back. Thank you, Marga and Rubén.
Very attentive and caring with pets, highly recommended

I've been taking my dog ​​Perla there since she was just over three months old, and every single time she's gone has been perfect—and there have been quite a few times.

Their love for dogs and their dedication are beyond question. There's always someone with them, they have plenty of space to play, they give them whatever you ask for, and they even have separate areas to divide the dogs according to their needs. I even left her there right after surgery when she couldn't play and needed rest, and they took excellent care of her. In fact, whenever I walk Perla and we pass by the place, she pulls right in.

I don't understand the negative comments, unless they're due to personal issues. I highly recommend the place.

Amor Perrijo is the best hotel I've ever left my dog ​​at. They are very responsible, attentive, and kind. They have spectacular service and exceptional treatment of animals. I trust them and their work 100%.

A terrible experience. I left my dog ​​in their care for five days with his medication clearly specified, and when I picked him up, he had such severe conjunctivitis that he had to be seen by a veterinarian immediately. Furthermore, they offered no explanation, shirked all responsibility, and showed absolutely no empathy. I would not recommend them at all.
I'm delighted with the staff at the daycare and their availability. I feel safe leaving my dogs in their care, and they're happy. 100% recommended. ⭐️
I took my 9-year-old dog, Kiwi, and they were really great. They returned him to me very happy and very clean. I would definitely go back.

The best place I could ever leave my dog, and I'm usually so particular about her care that I think no one else can do it like I do, but they've managed it perfectly. I trust them completely; I feel so at ease when I leave her with them. They give her so much love and attention. It's obvious—my dog ​​didn't want to go in the first day, and the second day she didn't want to leave. I'm truly grateful to have found them, and I can't thank them enough. Thank you for all the love you give her. Thank you, thank you, thank you! I will always recommend them!
Always excellent service and attention. Our Hache comes back happy every time we drop her off; she doesn't want to go home! You can tell she has a fantastic time! Thanks, Ruben :)

Hotel Animal AMOR PERRIJO has spacious and very clean facilities. It's a highly recommended place in Madrid where my dog ​​Archie has a fantastic time. Archie is always lovingly cared for by Marga and Rubén, who are experts in the field. Hotel Animal AMOR PERRIJO is the best place in Madrid to leave my dog ​​on the days I'm not working remotely and have to go to the office. Thank you so much, Marga and Rubén!
Honestly, I think it's a good place to leave your dogs. Rubén and Marga are very dedicated to them. Of course, if you bring in a bad dog, they'll do their best to help, but don't expect miracles...
Super friendly and professional people, very happy with the experience ☺️

An excellent place to leave my pets. The service, both to the animals and to the customers, has been fantastic.
They have a wide variety of pet products, and the shop is very well set up and clean. I highly recommend it.

Because you can't give half a star, even though they don't deserve even THAT, the way they treat the dogs is terrible. They're even capable of blaming you, they give away sick dogs and THAT'S not fair, it's abuse. Anyway, my advice: don't go!
I go very often and there is always good treatment towards pets and people.

I don't know where to begin... This place is a disgrace. The first time we took my dog, there wasn't much of a problem. I trusted them a second time, and they returned the dog in bad shape, vomiting. Supposedly, we had already brought him in like that. I left him one last time, thinking it was just a fluke and that the bad dog really was there. But this last time, they returned him extremely thin, with excuses that he wasn't eating and didn't know how to relieve himself outside. That he tried to eat his waste and so on. That he was aggressive with other dogs... when he never relieves himself inside and plays with other dogs outside without any problem.

If the dog isn't eating and they give me an empty bag of food, if the dog is very thin and has been overfed, then what's going on? We'll never see him again. I don't know what the hell they do to them there, but my dog ​​came out skin and bones...
